Eli (Sales): Passing Fieldstone Therapeutics to CS — 180-seat pilot, EU-only, wants private VPC deploy + SAML SSO + token-level billing export. Pilot target 2025-09-15. They will run synthetic PII during evals and asked about audit log retention and HSM later. Please own onboarding and call out any infra/compliance blockers.

Priya (CS): Thanks Eli. Quick Qs: who is their infra contact? expected pilot concurrency? Any renewal signals?

Eli (Sales): Contact is Dana (Fieldstone infra). Pilot concurrency ~35 users, ramp to ~220 in 3 months. Renewal interest: asked about a 12-month commit and tiered discounts.

Priya (CS): Top risks: EU private deploy lead time, SSO handoff, billing export format, and audit log PII retention. Tentative owners: Priya (onboarding lead), Marco (support lead), Sana (eng infra), Eli (sales sponsor). I'll open support ticket and schedule kickoff.

handoff-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-8001 "Fieldstone private deploy + SSO + billing export" assigned to Marco.

Marco (Support): Runbook stub in SUP-8001: - Validate SAML metadata exchange - VPC peering CIDR & routing - Billing export schema (CSV/JSON) - Audit log retention & redaction rules - Dedicated pool provisioning ETA.

Sana (Eng): Note: model family and max seq length change GPU footprint. If they pick ~13B gen we can use 2xA40 equiv; for 70B float plan 6-8xA100-80GB equiv. Provisioning lead ~7-12 business days region-dependent. Need model confirmation before provisioning.

Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Kickoff + enablement deck (Priya) 2) Open support ticket + runbook (Marco -> SUP-8001) 3) Confirm model & seq with customer (Eli -> Dana) 4) Billing export spec + sample (Priya + Billing Ops) 5) Provision dedicated pool after model confirmed (Sana) 6) Draft 1-page SSO checklist for Dana (Priya).

Eli (Sales): I'll ask Dana to confirm model family, sequence expectations, and billing cadence today. I'll also get legal PO timeline for the annual commit.

Marco (Support): I'll add a testing checklist in SUP-8001: SAML login test, VPC connectivity test, small ingest perf smoke, audit log verification. After kickoff we'll convert notes into a persistent internal doc.

Priya (CS): I'll add a "renewal-watch" tag in SFDC and set reminders at 180/120/60 days. I'll post the 1-page SSO checklist here before EOD. Keep updates in SUP-8001 and the kickoff calendar.
